changes.title: FAST finds two mysterious hydrogen clouds with no visible stars
changes.summary: Astronomers have found two clouds of hydrogen near the Whirlpool galaxy that appear to contain almost no stars. The clouds, discovered with China's FAST radio telescope, each contain roughly 3 million times the mass of the sun in hydrogen but have no detectable optical counterpart. changes.title: U.S. issues sanctions on Turkish bank that it calls a 'critical financial lifeline' for Iran
changes.summary: The Treasury Department accused the Turkish bank and its entities of being established to enable Iran's efforts to transfer oil revenues from China to Turkey, where they could then be converted to cash and gold.

changes.title: China Boycotts a Top Art Festival Over Taiwan Exhibition
changes.summary: China said the Gwangju Biennale in South Korea was misrepresenting Taiwan as an independent nation. Beijing claims it as its own.

changes.title: Volkswagen Plans to Cut 50,000 Jobs

changes.title: China's Xi visits Egypt for the first time in a decade
changes.summary: Xi Jinping's visit to Egypt for the first time in a decade, and during the Iran war, comes as U.S. allies broaden their security ties.

changes.title: Xi visits Egypt as China seeks deeper influence across the Mideast
changes.summary: China's President Xi Jinping visits Egypt this week for the first time in a decade. The trip illustrates China's growing ambitions at a time when U.S. influence has been weakened by its war in Iran. (Image credit: Xie Huanchi).

changes.title: Bessent says China agrees Iran shouldn't have nuclear weapons
changes.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said that China and the U.S. are on the same page regarding Iran having nuclear weapons. CBS News' Aaron MacLean reports.

changes.title: China presses U.S. for answers after a man dies hours after entering ICE custody
changes.summary: The Chinese government is pressing for answers after a Chinese man died hours after being taken into custody by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement in a U.S. territory. At least 57 ICE detainees have died since President Donald Trump returned to office in January 2025.
